row.proto: void *Career_Bank_CollectLedgerEntriesInRange(void *bank, void *out_vec, uint32_t team_key, uint32_t time_from, uint32_t time_to)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Finds the team account in bank+0x298..+0x2a0 (0x30 stride, key at +0x28) and, for each sub-account (0x1b0 stride at +0x10..+0x18), collects pointers to ledger entries (0x14 bytes each, timestamp at +0xc) with time in [time_from, time_to] into out_vec. Read-only; feeds the Team HQ finances view. Hook: this is the transaction history list.
